ownership: United States federal government public bank structure data
source_access: Public anonymous read-only API; FDIC documentation states a key is currently not required.
allowed_use: redistribution with attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing a current indexed location as independent confirmation of public access, current hours, or every service offered
representing FDIC coverage as all banks, credit unions, financial businesses, or all U.S. businesses
representing foreign offices with no U.S. state and state/county code 00 as U.S. locations
merging institutions or locations across sources without versioned evidence
using institution website links as an FDIC endorsement or authenticity guarantee
attribution: Source: FDIC BankFind Suite public API.
retention: Indefinite for public immutable source and normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed with FDIC attribution, pinned index metadata, provenance, temporal scope, and coverage limitations retained.
